description: This file implements a class for handling NetworkManager events on GNOME, including device state changes, IP address updates, WiFi scan results, and interface status, with callbacks and thread management.

classes.name: GnomeNetworkManagerEvents
classes.description: Handles GNOME NetworkManager events, including device state changes, IP address updates, WiFi scans, and interface status, with thread management and signal cleanup.

methods.name: startNetworkMangerEventMonitor
methods.description: Starts the network manager event monitoring thread.

methods.name: stopNetworkMangerEventMonitor
methods.description: Stops the network manager event monitoring thread.

methods.name: cleanupSignalHandlers
methods.description: Disconnects all signal handlers to clean up resources.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of GnomeNetworkManagerEvents.

methods.name: GnomeNetworkManagerEvents
methods.description: Constructor initializing the network manager client and main loop.

methods.name: networkMangerEventMonitor
methods.description: Thread function that sets up signal handlers and runs the main loop for network events.

methods.name: onActiveInterfaceChangeCb
methods.description: Callback for active interface change events.

methods.name: onInterfaceStateChangeCb
methods.description: Callback for interface state change events.

methods.name: onWIFIStateChanged
methods.description: Callback for WiFi state change events.

methods.name: onAddressChangeCb
methods.description: Callback for IP address changes, handles IPv4 and IPv6, and caches addresses.

methods.name: apToJsonObject
methods.description: Converts a network access point to a JSON object with SSID, security, strength, and frequency.

methods.name: onAvailableSSIDsCb
methods.description: Callback for available WiFi SSIDs scan results.

methods.name: setwifiScanOptions
methods.description: Configures whether WiFi scan results should be notified periodically.
